original_run_scope: All 53 E67 development winners checked by E75. This repair checks only the saved first-difference boundaries from natural starts, with no imports or resynchronization.

repairs.name: corruption_mummified
repairs.behavior: Corruption changes skill costs during power-action construction before relic callbacks.

repairs.name: darkling_power_reset
repairs.behavior: Darkling clears power amounts as well as presence flags before revival.

repairs.name: darkling_retaliation_regrow
repairs.behavior: Retaliation death queues the regrow move after the pending move roll.

repairs.name: necronomicon_play_limit
repairs.behavior: Copied cards obey current turn and card-play restrictions.

repairs.name: stasis_return_queue
repairs.behavior: Stasis returns after existing actions and keeps its hand/discard destination.

repairs.name: duplicate_no_draw_artifact
repairs.behavior: An existing No Draw rejects its duplicate before the Artifact check.

repairs.name: time_eater_debuff_order
repairs.behavior: Ripple applies Vulnerable, Weak, then Frail.

repairs.name: infernal_blood_for_blood
repairs.behavior: Infernal Blade generation applies previous HP-loss discounts.

repairs.name: dead_adventurer_elite_relics
repairs.behavior: Dead Adventurer combat triggers elite-only relics.

repairs.name: prismatic_shop_scope
repairs.behavior: Preserve the original shuffled shop pool; exclude only purchasing Prismatic Shard.

repairs.name: autoplay_shuffle_relics
repairs.behavior: Autoplay refilling an empty draw pile triggers shuffle relics.
